candidates.description:
If you're looking for a triceps workout that is easier on your joints, then you need to try the Smith Machine JM Press! This machine uses less weight and is more comfortable so you can train your triceps harder without hurting yourself.

In this video, I'll give you a detailed tutorial on how to use the Smith Machine JM Press and how to work your triceps in the best way possible. You'll be able to achieve strong, vascular triceps with this machine!
